what: Two 8px squares sit at each of the four outer corners of the cell grid — one dropped 128px outside the corner horizontally and one vertically — and they are tied to scroll (scrub 1, linear curve) from when the grid’s top edge reaches the bottom of the screen until its bottom edge reaches 75% of the screen, gathering into the corners. In the same range, 1px lines of full screen width are drawn from the left above and below the grid. This is an industry and service cell list whose dotted grid border is set by scrolling.

options.lines: If off, only the box without top and bottom lines
options.--fx-dot · --fx-color · --fx-rule: Square size (8px) · square color (--kf-ink) · line color (--kf-line)

note: Below 768px the box stays in place and the line is hidden (the original hides it on phones too)
